name: OpenAI
summary: The lab that made large language models a consumer product. GPT-3 set the template the whole field still follows, and ChatGPT turned it into a habit. OpenAI publishes benchmark numbers freely but keeps architecture and training details closed, and its pricing page blocks automated readers — so the data here leans harder on third-party sources than Anthropic's does.

founders.name: Sam Altman
founders.bio: Former president of Y Combinator; co-founded OpenAI in 2015 and has led it through the shift from research lab to product company.

founders.name: Ilya Sutskever
founders.bio: Co-author of AlexNet and a central figure in the deep learning revolution; departed in 2024.

founders.name: Greg Brockman
founders.bio: Former CTO of Stripe; OpenAI's first employee and longtime engineering lead.

founders.name: Wojciech Zaremba
founders.bio: Led the Codex work that became GitHub Copilot and the modern code-model line.

founders.name: John Schulman
founders.bio: Invented PPO, the reinforcement learning algorithm behind RLHF and instruction tuning.
